readings: head at -x: XY panel is the profile (nose left, hind leg trails to +x), ZY panel is the front view (shows left/right spread), XZ panel is the dorsal/top view
XY: nose (0,9), head-top (9,6), shoulder/front-leg root (11,10), front elbow (10,13), front foot (9,16)
XY: hip/pelvis root (16,11), hind knee (19,14), hind ankle (21,17), hind toe-tip (24,17)
ZY: eyes at z=9 and z=15 (y=6, matches XY head-top), front feet spread z=5 (right) and z=19 (left) at y=16 (matches XY front foot)
ZY: hind feet spread z=3 (right) and z=21 (left) at y=17 (matches XY hind foot/ankle)
Body midline taken at z=12 from ZY panel symmetry; XZ panel confirms lateral splay of both leg pairs and forward placement of head
notes: Frog has no external tail so only 5 leaves (head + 2 forelegs + 2 hindlegs); eyes/toes are sub-flap detail, not leaves. Spine simplified to a root trunk node splitting into a forward 'shoulder' girdle and rearward 'pelvis' girdle, matching the mesh's compact frog body. Each foreleg and hindleg is its own chain to the shared girdle node (never merged). Elbow (front leg) and knee/ankle (hind leg) joints are anatomical inferences splitting the single limb silhouette seen in the XY panel into upper/lower segments, using lateral (z) offsets read from the ZY front panel to give the characteristic splayed frog-leg bend. Left/right assigned assuming the ZY panel is a front (face-on) view, so image-right (+z) = animal's left side.
